move: grid of rounded squares spins twice with a rotation ripple outward
how: A 12x7 grid of 58px rounded squares, coloured in four concentric rings (periwinkle, mint, gold, pink) by distance from the centre, on deep navy. A seek function rotates every square 720deg per D minus 40deg per unit of distance, so the spin reads as a ripple spreading outward, and breathes scale between 0.72 and 1 on a sine wave with two cycles per D phased by the same distance. All terms are periodic so the 10s loop closes.
adapt: Change the four ring colours and background, grid density and square size or corner radius; a single colour with the ripple still reads well. Keep the whole turns per D and distance-phased rotation; D is 10s though the catalog lists 15.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the grid and squares recording each distance; animate(el, shot, D) returns a timeline with one linear progress tween over D whose onUpdate gsap.sets rotation and scale per square, replacing fx.register.
caveats: motion is a seek function, not tweens; port as a progress tween with onUpdate
duration is 10s, not the 15s listed in the catalog
